AppFunctionAppMetadata.appfn:instructions:
OpenBite is a personal dining journal for restaurants the user has visited, mostly while travelling. Its functions list upcoming milestones such as anniversaries and birthdays, search past dining logs, search saved places, read a saved place's menu, and add a new dining log.
Operational patterns: - Call 'upcomingMilestones' to get a milestoneId, then 'queryDiningLogs' with that milestoneId to see where earlier celebrations were held. - Call 'searchPlaces' to get a placeId, then 'getPlaceMenu' to get dishIds, then 'createDiningLog' with those dishIds. - 'upcomingMilestones' already includes up to 5 earlier meals per milestone; call 'queryDiningLogs' only when more are needed.
Constraints: - Only saved places can be logged; no function adds a place or a menu. - 'createDiningLog' only adds a draft dated now; no function edits or deletes existing data. - Results contain no photos, file paths, receipts or paid amounts. Prices are menu prices in the currency's smallest unit. - Lists are capped: 50 dining logs, 50 places, 300 menu dishes.
